svg.aria-label: Architecture: ANAC CSVs are uploaded to a Unity Catalog Volume, ingested with PySpark into bronze, typed and checked by Spark Declarative Pipelines in silver with a diagnostic quarantine view, and modeled in gold as a fact table, an airport dimension and a one big table, consumed by BI dashboards and the Genie AI agent. Unity Catalog governs all layers.
